dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: How buyers found you, and what each channel is worth.
dashboard.metric_revenue_help: Matched to real orders, by currency
dashboard.response_rate_no_orders: No orders in this period yet
dashboard.pending_banner_title_one: {{count}} answer is waiting for order details
dashboard.pending_banner_title_other: {{count}} answers are waiting for order details
dashboard.pending_banner_body: These buyers answered before Shopify sent us the order. Revenue appears once the order arrives, usually within a minute. The answers themselves are already saved.
dashboard.locked_banner_title_one: {{count}} answer came in after your plan limit
dashboard.locked_banner_title_other: {{count}} answers came in after your plan limit
dashboard.locked_banner_body: They are stored and already counted in the totals above. Upgrade to remove the limit.
dashboard.trend_empty_title: Not enough data to chart yet
dashboard.trend_empty_body: Once a couple of days have answers, the trend appears here.
dashboard.trend_aria: Responses per day. {{total}} responses across {{days}} days, peaking at {{peak}} on {{date}}.
dashboard.channels_subtitle: Answers and the revenue they map to.
dashboard.empty_body: Once buyers answer your question on the thank-you page, their answers and the value of the orders they placed will show up here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: This is the question buyers see after they order.
settings.saved_body: Saved. Your question is live on the next checkout.
settings.save_failed_body: We could not save your changes. Your previous question is still live. Please try again.
settings.not_installed: This store is not installed yet. Reopen the app to reinstall.
settings.question_panel_description: Keep it short. One tap answers it.
settings.field_question_details: Shown at the top of the survey. Example: How did you hear about us?
settings.options_panel_description: Between {{min}} and {{max}} options. Buyers tap one to answer.
settings.other_panel_description: Let buyers type their own answer instead.
settings.other_switch_details: Adds an “Other” choice where buyers can type their own. Useful while you are still discovering channels.
settings.language_panel_description: Choose the language SourceTrac uses. This applies straight away.

onboarding.title: Get started
onboarding.subtitle: Three steps to your first attributed order.
onboarding.step1_title: Enable the survey in the checkout editor
onboarding.step1_body_orders: We have received order data, so the survey can be shown to buyers.
onboarding.step1_body: Add the SourceTrac block to your thank-you page and your order status page.
onboarding.step2_body_other: Your answer options are set, and buyers can type their own.
onboarding.step2_body: Choose the {{min}} to {{max}} ways customers find you, and order them however you like.
onboarding.step3_body_done: You have answers. The dashboard shows what each channel is worth.
onboarding.step3_body: Place a test order, then answer the question on the thank-you page. It appears on your dashboard within a minute.
onboarding.why_title: Why step 1 asks you to confirm
onboarding.why_body: Shopify does not tell apps whether a checkout block is switched on, so we cannot tick this for you. If the survey is not appearing on your thank-you page, check that the SourceTrac block is added and visible there.
onboarding.language_step_body: You can change this later in Settings.

export.title: Export
export.subtitle: Download every answer as a spreadsheet, newest last.
export.empty_body: You have no answers to export yet. Once buyers start answering, they will appear here.
export.count_body_one: This file will contain all {{count}} of your answers.
export.count_body_other: This file will contain all {{count}} of your answers.
export.columns_note: Columns: {{columns}}. There is no customer name, email or address in the file.
export.preview_description: Your {{count}} most recent answers, exactly as they will export.

plans.title: Plans
plans.subtitle: Choose how many answers you collect each month.
plans.cancel_body: Your answers stay saved and your survey keeps working. You lose unlimited responses.
plans.not_available: Billing is unavailable right now. Please try again shortly.

help.title: Help
help.subtitle: Answers to the questions we are asked most.
help.contact_body: Tell us what is happening and we will take a look.

shell.plan_blocked_title: SourceTrac is not available on your plan
shell.plan_blocked_body: The survey needs a paid Shopify plan. It cannot appear on your checkout or order status page while your store is on Starter. Upgrade your Shopify plan to start collecting answers.
shell.cap_warning_title: You have used {{used}} of your {{cap}} responses
shell.cap_warning_body_one: Answers are still being collected and already counted in your dashboard. Once you reach {{cap}} this month, later answers are still saved and still counted too — upgrade to remove the limit.
shell.cap_warning_body_other: Answers are still being collected and already counted in your dashboard. Once you reach {{cap}} this month, later answers are still saved and still counted too — upgrade to remove the limit.
shell.cap_reached_title: Your free response limit is reached
shell.cap_reached_body: Every answer is still saved and still counted in your dashboard. Nothing is hidden or held back — upgrade to lift the monthly limit.

language.select_body: SourceTrac will use this language across the app. You can change it any time in Settings.
language.save_error: We could not save your language. Please try again.
